notes.title: Update notes v2.4.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjusted air smash input when using a controller to be triggered only when no horizontal inputs are detected.
[*] Adjusted contrast in Thorns textures for better visibility.
[*] Adjusted small visual details in some stages.
[*] Fixed collision detections with the Lizard that made it lose momentum with Banana cannons.
[*] Fixed controller disconnection freezing the game when more than one controller is attached.
[*] Fixed Eggplant desynchronization issue in Jelly Jungle after checkpoint respawn.
[*] Fixed issue introduced in the previous patch in which Onions would not spawn in Scales Showdown at end of the stage.
[*] Fixed missing death triggers in Jelly Dungeon stage.
[*] Fixed projectile issues for some system with specific default languages.
[*] Fixed slingshot collisions glitches.
[*] Fixed collision issue when attacking Dragonfruit in a slope.
[*] Fixed Typhoon not detecting dash attack as final damage and increased reaction time for the player to perform final damage.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes v2.3.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved load management of music files, to prevent scenarios where music could not play.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Slippery carrot in Stage Sliding Salad could appear from nowhere in some situations.
[*] Small challenge adjustments on Forgotten Mask stage.
[*] Adjusted some moving platforms not being synchronized as they should in Tiger Popsicle.
[*] Fixed an issue where using the attack button to fire yourself from a slingshot while using mask tiger could lead to a dash soon after the shot.
[*] Changed order of "Restart Level" command in Pause Screen to come after "Resume".
[*] Fixed an issue where exiting difficulty screen during confirmation dialogue would not clear commands and level would be restarted soon after a few inputs.
[*] Fixed scenario where a special cinematic which triggered the "Wait... What?" achievement could not play.
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/bba504bd7db39399c6866cb46d6aa39242b41f2c.png[/img]

[b][h1]WINNER WINNER CARROT DINNER?
[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/278912613922cc454173d29df04eaffb5dfd7c42.png[/img]

During the spooky days of October, we’ve participated in the Games Festival of SBGames 2018. SBGames is a yearly event focused on the Brazilian game development scene; one of its main features is its games festival, in which Brazilian indie games are played and evaluated by industry veterans. It’s like the Oscars but for Brazilian indie games!
In 2017, we were nominated for Best Visual Art category...
This year, we were nom- [b]WE WON TWO AWARDS![/b]
We were nominated for both [b]Best Game[/b] & [b]Best Visual Art[/b] and we won. [b]Twice[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/a2f5d7b425015a32273eacc705e208c9e5cbbf7f.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/53e5fcdb1038c25b03343503dad9806c3873f2d4.jpg[/img]
[i]These are trophy mugs, which make them even MORE USEFUL than an Oscar! (We’re with you Josef Fares!)[/i]

This is absolutely amazing, and of course, it wouldn’t have been possible without all of the support you have given us so far. Thank you so much!
This award only reinforces our commitment to releasing the best game possible to all of you. 

[h1]DEVELOPMENT UPDATE[/h1]

[b]New Air Glide animation[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/b0a301ff633dbebd84dccc20ee0e0f0614a0fa53.gif[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/60569d584a0b96fead2411121be4300266e89b8f.gif[/img]

We gave Kaze’s glide a new [i]spin[/i].
With the new animation, it’s much easier to follow Kaze’s position precisely while also making the glide more distinct from the ground spin attack, which will help with kazes where players mistook one for the other. What do you think?

[b]Enemies[/b]
Are you up to date with the new amount of enemies our game will have? No? Then let’s get to it:

[b]Onion Mole[/b]
When it comes to designing new enemies, we certainly[i] know our onions[/i].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/fd6d0f87455ef4119126797f730831a1fca9cf56.gif[/img]

[b]Helmet Beet[/b]
This enemy is [i]unbeetable[/i], but you may use it to your advantage!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/7eb78875ce0283bf8ecb7fea5f0d7f0d12713ce1.gif[/img]

[b]Flaming Pumpkin[/b]
[i]NYAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAH[/i] - Don’t get close or you'll burn!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/4379c8cffcb38ec99ae4fbf16fb877c72bad1bab.gif[/img]

[h1]SINGLE LEVEL PLAYTHROUGH[/h1]

[url=https://youtu.be/mEXqTxvCbX8][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/8b52c234e7bee2d9d0e157b760e859feaf7ed10f.png[/img][/url]

If you want to see how our game plays out, here’s a complete level gameplay from start to end. Tell us what do you think!

--

That’s it for this devlog! 

Please send us your feedback so we can continue to improve it.

You can also subscribe to our newsletter to be the first to receive these updates

[b]Newsletter:[/b] http://playkaze.com/newsletter/

[i][b]Until next time!
[/b][/i]

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/3376df1dc7bc4a68a24df4fc76bcf3ece606cee8.png[/img]

[b]And here we are again![/b]

A lot of cool stuff happened in the last month, and as always, we are working super duper hard to finish the project and deliver to you guys a truly 90s classic platformer game but also expanding this experience with present-day features...

[b][i]So here are today’s headlines...[/i][/b]

[h1]WE ARE FINALISTS![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/63f01ab826e6dbe885f11a7757493447387b41b0.png[/img]

We have been selected as finalists in the Strasbourg Indie Game Contest that will start in the 15 of September along with the Strasbourg Film Festival! Kaze will be available to play there during the week, so if you live nearby you should definitely check it out! Other really cool games will also be available to play there so if you’re into Indie Gaming this is a really interesting event to attend!

[h1]MORE COOL FEATURES AND LEVELS[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/431d4ccf22456c60f1341bb1a60b56b8083fe77d.png[/img]

You’ll encounter some fun objects to interact within the levels. The one above (we are currently calling it the Jellyspring) will act as a “spring” that will help you jump higher and gain momentum!

And below is our sling/catapult/gearing thing(please suggest a better name for us!). This object can automatically launch Kaze [i]reeeeally[/i] fast in its target direction. There will also be variations of this object where you can control the directions where you can go and only launch it after pressing a button!

[i]Note that both of these are WIP assets that are subject to change and doesn’t represent the final product.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/1d4cae0608a72504acb48481067a2ec3aa45f76f.gif[/img]

[h1]DEVELOPMENT STREAMS![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32403781/8675a25981e8044dcc40b5e7214c87352b109ec9.png[/img]

As some of you may know, we’ve created a Twitch account and are starting to stream the development process of the game. Last week’s stream was with our artist creating enemy animations!
We don’t have a fixed stream schedule yet but we’ll try to do it regularly if we feel that you guys are enjoying it! So head over to http://twitch.tv/kazewildmasks and follow us to know when the next stream happens and with that also encourage us to do more frequent streams!

---

Aaand that’s it for now!
Please send us your feedback! Any questions? What do you want to see in the next devlog? Feel free to comment with anything you want! (with manners, of course =D)

You can also subscribe to our newsletter to be the first to receive these updates!
Newsletter: http://playkaze.com/newsletter/

[b][i]Until next time![/i][/b]
